faq_q1.en: What happens after I accept a quote?

faq_a1.en: We confirm your details and schedule a convenient pickup time — usually within a few business hours. Payment is arranged at collection.
faq_a1.ar: نؤكد بياناتك ونحدد موعد استلام مناسب — عادة خلال ساعات عمل قليلة. يتم ترتيب الدفع عند الاستلام.

faq_q2.en: Do you charge for scrap car collection?

faq_a2.en: No. Free scrap car pickup is included with every accepted quote across Dubai and the UAE.
faq_a2.ar: لا. الاستلام المجاني مشمول مع كل عرض مقبول في دبي والإمارات.

faq_q3.en: How soon will my car be picked up?

faq_a4.en: All brands and models — Toyota, Nissan, BMW, Mercedes, Ford, Hyundai, and more including vans.

faq_a5.en: Payment is made via secure bank transfer after vehicle collection. Cash payments are not used for security.
faq_a5.ar: يتم الدفع عبر تحويل بنكي آمن بعد استلام السيارة. لا نستخدم الدفع النقدي لأسباب أمنية.

faq_a6.en: A basic inspection or photo evaluation is usually enough for a fair, fast offer.

faq_a7.en: Yes. We can evaluate and purchase multiple vehicles in one go.
